versions.title: readable compact channel names above separate favorite controls
versions.description: P5.1.132 genuine Electron screenshot `positron-p51132-empty-search-clear-after-450-real.png` shows two-column 450px grid cards whose long "QA Channel 00…" labels are truncated beside the separate bottom Favorite star. Fix only in multi-result compact native GRID (not list, not wide single-result): reserve a dedicated 34px bottom action row; allow name to wrap to two lines; center the original 34px independent Favorite control below the title. Preserve native play action, keyboard and stored Favorite keys.

versions.title: Recover from empty channel search without reimporting
versions.description: Fix: when there are imported channels but no search results on All and search/group filters are active, add one native "Xóa bộ lọc và xem tất cả kênh" button. On click clear query and group, render all 18 page-1 cards and restore search focus. Existing CSS reused. Screenshots: `positron-p51132-empty-search-clear-before-450-real.png`, `positron-p51132-empty-search-clear-after-450-real.png`.

versions.title: Search 'đ' using ASCII 'd' in channel library
versions.description: Fix: append `replace(/đ/g,'d')` after lower-casing in the native chooser search normalizer; applies equally to typed text, channel names and group names. Original metadata is unchanged. Actual Electron regression: with nine locally imported QA category records, search `dia phuong` must return precisely "TH QA 1" (original group "TH địa phương"), live 1-channel status and focus; clearing restores 18 cards. No IPTV playback, favorites or playlist changes.

versions.title: Cover clipped category-chip outline alongside sticky reset
versions.description: Fix: adjust conditional right mask to 30px; leave mask completely off at scrollLeft=0. Native group chips, selection, playlist, keyboard, play controls and local state unchanged.

versions.title: Repair clipped group-chip text in compact Electron
versions.description: Fix: native scroll synchronization toggles `po-groups-scrolled`; scoped right-side `::after` mask applies only while scrolled. No changes to playlist, playback, favorites, stored data or group semantics.

versions.title: Reveal active quick-group after advanced filter change
versions.description: Fix: on explicit dropdown group change, scroll only the currently active matching quick chip into view; resetting to All restores the rail start. Preserve original chip click focus restoration, no group/playlist write or automatic playback. Keep the historical `POSITRON_P5_CHANGELOG.md` intact in the bundled source, publish short notes with a pointer to the full file, and add a Node regression assertion against using full changelog as release notes.

versions.title: Arrow-key channel group navigation on compact displays
versions.description: Fix: add an event listener scoped to the native category row to focus previous/next/start/end buttons and scroll their target into view; changes no filters until explicit Enter/Space, preserves All button, no auto-play or source mutation.

versions.title: Mask clipped channel labels behind compact pinned All reset
versions.description: Fix: add a scoped 22px dark mask using the original first chip's own ::before and let it capture pointer events, preventing invisible category selection in the masked region. Do not remove native group controls or modify playlists/playback.

versions.title: Pin All Channels reset while browsing compact groups
versions.description: Fix: make only the first native chip position:sticky at the left edge <=600px, preserving the full group catalog, native wheel/touch/keyboard, focus restoration and playlist/player behavior. It remains a normal button, no duplicate UI. New regression: Node test and actual Electron 450px screenshot `positron-p51125-pinned-all-450-real.png` plus geometry, hit-target, actual filter switch/reset, focus, overflow checks.

versions.title: Mouse-wheel navigation for compact channel groups
versions.description: Fix: wheel-to-horizontal navigation while rail can move, release native page scroll at edges, toned scroll indicator. Preserve touch, keyboard, group filters, favorite data, playlist and media transport. Verification: new Node regression, actual Electron 450px wheel/color/edge/overflow checks and screenshot `positron-p51124-chip-wheel-450-real.png`. Candidate pending CI, direct after-image and immutable binary release.

versions.title: Dismissible accessible notifications
versions.description: Fix: at <=600px, success-only notifications dock into 36px existing footer strip at bottom:2px. Long success text ellipsizes, X remains 32x32. Any warnings or errors restore original elevated position/height and severity. Core native toast timers, state, channel data and playback untouched. Electron QA: real 450px footer and toast DOM bounding boxes, warning persistence, no overflow, photo `positron-p51123-success-toast-footer-450-real.png`. Candidate until all six CI jobs, direct visual review and installer Release verified.

versions.title: Dismissible accessible notifications
versions.description: Fix: track last genuinely focused control outside #toastArea and restore if still connected and enabled. Preserve native toast timers, severity, M3U, favorites and playback. Actual Electron QA: focus #webChooserSearch, append isolated warning toast, press Enter to dismiss, assert return focus/no overflow; after-image `positron-p51122-toast-focus-return-450-real.png`. Node syntax guard. Candidate until CI and image/release verification.

versions.title: Dismissible accessible notifications
versions.description: Isolated Positron DOM observer adds keyboard/touch accessible native close button to each notification; original toast data, severity, auto expiration and app playback remain unchanged. Scoped contrast and 32px pointer target; real Electron screenshot `positron-p51121-toast-dismiss-visible-450-real.png` and QA must test mouse click and keyboard Enter, proper accessible label and no overflow.

versions.title: Compact mobile success notifications
versions.description: Fix: compact Positron-only CSS shows latest success while retaining warning/error notices, expiry timers and desktop behavior. Real Electron 450px regression with three benign fixture notices, warning visibility, sidebar clearance and no overflow; after screenshot `positron-p51120-compact-toast-stack-450-real.png`.

versions.title: Live accessible Favorites counter on native chooser tab
versions.description: Fix: add badge AFTER legacy SVG tab-icon replacement, update its count on every native chooser render from favorites.visible(store), hide at zero, use aria-label "Yêu thích, N kênh", overlay small pill near icon without taking width away from 450px tab row; no playlist data mutation. Final HEAD `9751d3c02c2a293c63301f066b16b079a2d884ff`, immutable tag `positron/v4.23.202-p5.1.118`, GitHub Actions `44935525440` 6/6 success. Node 718: 713 passed, 5 skipped, no failure. Real screenshot opened, 13/13 direct Favorite assertions true including stored key, remove/reverse, focus and no playback; 4 binary release assets verified.

versions.title: Native bookmark directly on channel tiles without playback
versions.description: Fix: each main grid tile keeps original native Play button and gains a separate accessible native Favorite button as a sibling, not nested inside Play. Uses existing OpenIPTVFavorites.toggle/getStore/save/render, stable favorite keys, persistence and in-memory rollback if save fails; native Favorites tab reactivity preserved. Compact side mini cards remain native Play buttons. Affected CSS: add wrapper as grid cell, keep P117 one-result full-width behavior, subtle native star with aria-pressed and focus; multi-channel grid, video playback and stored sources unchanged.

versions.title: Readable full-width single filtered channel tile on compact view
versions.description: Cause: two-column responsive grid applies even when only one button is visible on the page. Fix: compact-only :only-child channel button spans all grid columns and uses a horizontal logo-title arrangement with original click-to-play, keyboard and list mode preserved; multi-result grid remains two columns.

versions.title: Validate native quick-category chips against imported groups
versions.description: Fix: quick chips only for actually imported group names (TH matches a separate token rather than the beginning of Thể thao). Selected chip state now uses aria-pressed; native keyboard focus restored after filtering; no changes to stream playback or saved playlists.

versions.title: Remove duplicate compact empty Favorites and Recent panels
versions.description: Fix: mark only duplicate empty mini section on its own active tab and hide it only <=650px via scoped CSS. Keep mini section on All, other tabs, desktop, and when actually populated. No stored data, filtering or playback changed.

versions.title: Actionable Favorites and Recent empty states
versions.description: Fix: context-specific empty messages for Favorites and Recent, native "Xem tất cả kênh" action that clears local search/group filters and restores All tab focus without autoplay; hide pager on one-page or empty results; preserve playlist and favorites data.

versions.title: Keyboard navigation for native channel chooser tabs
versions.description: Fix: preserve original native click-to-select, add directional/Home/End keyboard focus, selected tab only in Tab sequence, aria-controls; Favorites/Recent/channel playback and stored data unchanged.

versions.title: Readable two-column channel cards on compact view
versions.description: Cause: legacy `web-channel-chooser-v42371.css` uses 80px minimum columns at <=650px and single-line ellipsis for labels, making channel titles hard to identify. Fix: narrow <=500x900 unplayed/regular grid (not list mode) uses 2 equal columns with min 145px card width and two-line names; original native channel button, click, logo, pagination, stream logic and responsive desktop layout stay untouched.

versions.title: Single-row scrolling channel category filters
versions.description: Fix: Positron <=600px horizontal overflow strip with native buttons all present + focus accessible; `renderGroups()` saves/restores scrollLeft to prevent jumping to the start after selecting a chip near the right side. Group filtering and playlist never altered.

versions.title: Compact idle player on narrow viewports
versions.description: Fix: when viewport <=600x900 only, compact idle onboarding canvas to 164px, remove decorative empty TV icon on narrow view, tighten text/CTA spacing. Native playback retains original 16:9 stage immediately as soon as the empty illustration hides, and remains untouched at fullscreen or larger screens. No playlist or stream changes.

versions.title: Deduplicate active notifications
versions.description: Fix: coalesce only the same text + severity while the previous toast is still mounted. Different messages or severity remain visible; timeout still removes existing toast after 5.5 seconds. Existing IPTV data, local playlist, player, source and accessibility live region are unchanged.

versions.title: Narrow toast respects icon rail
versions.description: Cause: the shared native `.toast-area` uses right:24px/max-width:380px with no left constraint for the compact sidebar. Fix: Positron-only <=600px notification lane left:66px/right:12px; text wraps safely and the visual toast does not intercept taps. Native toast content, timers, IPTV data and playback remain untouched.

versions.title: Replace font-dependent compact channel chooser icons with SVG
versions.description: Actual P5.1.106 native Electron TV screenshots at 450px/540px: channel chooser tabs and grid/list toggles still use platform text-glyph symbols (▣, ☆, ◷, ▦, ☷) rather than a coherent icon set. Some appear like isolated small squares. Fix inside Positron branch only: render five deterministic SVG icons, preserve all existing click listeners, role/tab selection, channel playlist data, and no-autoplay semantics. Give grid/list toggles explicit accessible names.

versions.title: Empty WatchFlow without a horizontal scrollbar
versions.description: Real screenshot P5.1.105 `positron-watchflow-1360-night-real.png` reveals a horizontal scrollbar in compact no-source WatchFlow. Scoped fix matches the 15px padding, preserving playback, saved bookmarks, other modal modes and user data.

versions.title: Explicit two-step cleanup of unavailable bookmarks (new batch 04/20)
versions.description: Opened P5.1.104 actual Electron screenshot `positron-p51104-watchlater-unavailable-552-real.png`: status notice tells users a source is unavailable but gives no way to free dormant saved slots while retaining healthy bookmarks. Add opt-in details manager. Display only sanitized normalized bookmark keys, never source URL, token or full M3U. On first click change the action to `Xác nhận bỏ` without any data write; on second confirm revalidate that the selected fingerprint is still unavailable before removing only that bookmark from localStorage. Never auto-remove when source is offline.

versions.title: Inform about dormant Watch Later bookmarks without deleting them (new batch 03/20)
versions.description: Reviewed actual P5.1.103 Electron screenshot `positron-p51103-watchlater-cap-after-real.png`, inspected the strict 80-entry limit and found stored bookmarks for dead/removed channels are silently hidden by `visible()`; users may think saved data vanished. Add `unavailable(rows,channels)` to count fingerprints with no currently playable matching native channel, source-scoped and without checking stream URLs externally. UI shows a quiet privacy-preserving note while keeping all bookmarks in localStorage for source recovery. No auto-delete, autoplay or network fetch.

versions.title: Stop silent Watch Later bookmark eviction at 80 (new batch 02/20)
versions.description: Followed the P5.1.102 real `positron-p51102-watch-later-multiterm-552-real.png` screenshot and its saved-list status back into `toggle()`: with 80 saved channels, the 81st was inserted at the front and `compact()` discarded the oldest without warning. Preserve all prior bookmarks: refuse a new save at capacity with `{ok:false,reason:'full'}`; existing saved channels may still be removed, and a new channel may be saved after freeing a slot.

versions.title: Watch Later multi-word, group and quality-aware search (new 20-round batch 01/20)
versions.description: Opened real P5.1.101 screenshot `positron-p51101-watch-later-search-552-real.png`: searching only a contiguous substring cannot find saved `QA Channel 001` with cross-field `main 001`, although native group metadata is present. Keep personal bookmarks local; search accent-insensitively across multiple title/group terms, in any order. Do not strip HD, FHD or 4K query tokens as bookmark fingerprints do; punctuation-only input must not accidentally reveal all saved channels.

versions.title: Search within all privately saved Watch Later channels
versions.description: Evidence from actual P5.1.100 Electron screenshot and source: saved Watch Later entries are accessible in batches but up to 80 entries require many manual scroll/reveal actions to find a particular channel. Provide a persistent accessible search field on the Continue screen. Filter locally resolved saved channel titles or group names, with Vietnamese accent-insensitive matching, and show result counts. No URL search, network requests, data upload, playlist changes or automatic playback. The local-only bookmark schema remains unchanged.

versions.title: WatchFlow header and mode tabs remain visible in long saved lists
versions.description: Real P5.1.98 Electron screenshots of 12 saved bookmarks demonstrate that the close icon and mode tabs disappear after scrolling to the end, even with accessible bookmark pagination. Keep header and mode selector sticky in the existing WatchFlow dialog, using compact typography and dark background while preserving the native TV transport, EPG, and local-only saved state.

versions.title: Upcoming programme in WatchFlow directly from XMLTV
versions.description: Feature: extend actual Now cards with the first Next XMLTV programme and its local start time. Reuse `IPTVGuide.current()` and existing channel/manual mappings, EPG offset and user's device time zone. Never infer a programme title from a channel or network search. Show Next only if its schedule starts after the present instant, has valid end time, an actual title and starts within 12 hours. Avoid misleading 'up next tomorrow' from incomplete guides. Do not load extra sources, auto-play a channel or alter native playlists.

versions.title: On-air XMLTV programme titles in WatchFlow recommendations
versions.description: Research basis: the imported XMLTV guide already backs native EPG search and reminders, but WatchFlow cards show only channel names and source health. IPTVnator's channel list offers Now/Next EPG inline; copy no external assets/code. Enhancement: add only the **currently airing** actual XMLTV programme title under relevant WatchFlow card names, using the existing guide from `IPTVExtras.getGuide()`, `IPTVGuide.current()`, manual channel mapping and saved EPG offset. One line of readable text with full title in a tooltip. No programme title is shown without matching, currently active guide data; no guessed programme info.

versions.title: Watch Later pagination: all saved channels reachable
versions.description: Fixed a confirmed accessibility and functionality gap: Watch Later retained up to 80 bookmarks but Continue displayed only the first eight, making entries 9–80 unreachable. Continue now shows the count of available saved channels, initially renders eight, and offers an accessible "Xem thêm" control in groups of eight. Native playback remains explicit and does not start on saving or expanding.

versions.title: WatchFlow Xem sau: private local channel bookmarks
versions.description: Feature motivation: real open-source IPTV ecosystem increasingly has favorites, history and quick-return interfaces; the existing native history intentionally records only decoded playback, so a separate deliberate 'Xem sau' saves a choice even when the user has not played it. Related research: `POSITRON_FEATURE_RESEARCH_NEXT20_20261121.md`. Implementation: from the original WatchFlow Mix/Similar/Continue cards, add keyboard-accessible `Lưu` / `Bỏ lưu` beside the existing native `Xem`. In the existing Tiếp tab, saved channels appear in a `Để xem sau` section above native successfully played history; no new sixth tab crowds the modal. Save toggle never

versions.title: Correct visible overlay of WatchFlow scroll cue
versions.description: Direct manual review of the REAL P5.1.94 Electron screenshot `positron-p5194-watchflow-scroll-cue-552-real.png` revealed an important new defect: the indicator `↓ Cuộn xuống để xem thêm kênh` sat over the third Mix card's `Xem` button. Pointer-events:none made the button technically clickable, but visual occlusion is unacceptable. P5.1.94 was therefore not counted as a fully reviewed round. Cause: indicator was an absolute-positioned child at the bottom of a 390px, scroll-clipped dialog.

versions.title: Expose hidden WatchFlow Mix suggestions when desktop panel scrolls
versions.description: Fix: preserve the current 390px max-height and native playback, source files, and user preferences; add a passive on-panel visual cue `↓ Cuộn xuống để xem thêm kênh` only when the final recommendation card is actually outside the panel bounds. Recompute on scroll, resize, mode switch and reopen; hide when the last card becomes visible or panel closes, prevent pointer interception.

versions.title: Balance daily Mix source groups with equal playback evidence
versions.description: New regression tests: 3 groups × 14 channels, 5 picks with [1,2,2] group counts on four dates, no duplicates, different dates rotate, and an actually proven stream remains included. Native Electron 552-channel QA measures rendered card group counts, no autoplay and generates `positron-p5193-group-balanced-mix-552-real.png`. This version is a candidate until test, native screenshot opening, CI and immutable installer assets are verified. No playlist/history modifications and no network or streaming during QA.

versions.title: Correct daily Mix and Smart Zap calendar day
versions.description: Added pure `localDay(date)` helper using the device Date local year/month/day. The Mix UI and engine defaults now use the local day consistently, including Smart Zap. Explicit date arguments remain supported, and recommendation health/dedup/privacy continue unchanged. New Node regression launches child processes in `TZ=Asia/Bangkok` and `TZ=UTC` for the **same instant** 2026-11-20T18:30:00Z and confirms Nov21 in Bangkok but Nov20 UTC. Real Electron QA asserts five Mix recommendations remain clickable, mode selected, never autoplay, and local date key; captures `positron-p5192-local-calendar-mix-552-real.png`.

versions.title: Match native Play/Pause glyphs to Web original SVG
versions.description: Read the **Web branch only** and bring its exact SVG data URI masks for Play and Pause into the Positron-specific media CSS. Restore 22×22 consistent stroke geometry. Preserve the existing original Play button, click handlers, MutationObserver deriving state from native app glyph, disabled style, current theme colors, player and media IPC; no other branch changed. Native Electron CDP QA temporarily updates only decorative Play text (without clicks, playback or network requests), asserts CSS SVG mask, 22px sizing, proper switch to Pause and restoration, then captures `positron-p5191-web-play-svg-552-metadata-real.png`.

versions.title: Hide experimental Video Lab when nothing is selected
versions.description: Remove that dead-end from the **unselected** player UI only. Keep button and settings in DOM, restore it when native selected channel exists, and collapse its panel when selection ends. Monitor native title and component initialization rather than mutating playlists or media pipeline. Node tests and real Electron metadata-only QA assert the button is hidden and not taking space with no current channel; with a temporarily stubbed channel selection it becomes visible, and after restoring native state it hides again, all without starting video. Screenshot `positron-p5190-player-ready-video-lab-hidden-552-metadata-real.png`.

versions.title: Native player status reflects available channels
versions.description: Synchronize only the native *default* `#playingSubtitle` hint with native enabled-channel count. Change the default to `Chọn kênh để bắt đầu` when channels are present, restore the original import hint when none are. Never overwrite status labels after a user stops video or when a channel is already selected or playing. Add Node assertion and real Electron metadata screenshot `positron-p5189-player-ready-subtitle-552-metadata-real.png`, including a CDP check that UI state and caption agree and playback remains stopped.

versions.title: Real playlist-aware TV onboarding
versions.description: Keep the native no-playlist onboarding intact. When enabled native channels are available, show `Chọn kênh để xem` and accurate channel count, preserve the file/URL buttons in DOM but hide them, and offer `Xem kênh đầu tiên` which invokes the existing `IPTVState.playChannel(first.id)` **only after a real user click**. The first eligible enabled source is used; dead and missing-link channels are not selected. No autoplay, playlist mutation or network lookup. Observe native `channelMeta` for source import/removal updates; restore original import actions when there are zero enabled channels. Preserve the existing player, playback and source data.

versions.title: WatchFlow tabs stay readable
versions.description: Replace the short visible label with “Tiếp”; the accessible `aria-label` and `title` remain the complete “Tiếp tục xem”. No watch-history, stream, channel, or EPG behavior changes. Add regression assertions and **real Electron DOM geometry checks** for five mode-label widths (span.scrollWidth <= span.clientWidth) in the same populated WatchFlow screenshot, retaining existing nav overflow and button-width validations.

versions.title: Prevent WatchFlow dialog from covering native player
versions.description: Visual input is the actual Electron 1360×820 screenshot from P5.1.85 at `p5-20-rounds/positron-watchflow-plus-similar-552-metadata-qa-real.png`; popup (top ~72, bottom ~680) covered the entire right part of native player controls (top ~487). Fix desktop-short viewport WatchFlow popup to a 390px *border-box* maximum with an internal scroll bar. Keep five clickable native metadata suggestions and keyboard-accessible controls; don't alter native playback, playlists, history, or recommendations.

versions.title: WatchFlow Plus Similar ranking
versions.description: Inspected the actual P5.1.84 Electron WatchFlow screenshots. The Similar code first sorted by exact source group but then resorted all matches by playback score and alphabetical name, erasing group ordering for equally proven streams. Fixed evidence-first ordering with same-group as the next tie-breaker. Proven streams retain priority over unverified streams. Input playlists and watch history remain untouched.

versions.title: Actionable empty channel sidebar (new batch round 07/20)
versions.description: Actual P5.1.83 TV Electron screenshot shows the channel sidebar occupying substantial space with passive no-channel text and no direct action, in contrast to the functional main player CTA. When native IPTVState.getChannels() has zero channels, replace only the native no-channel description with a compact title, explanation and real source-management CTA. The existing channel list and all metadata/favorites are untouched. MutationObserver tracks native list re-renders; after importing a playlist, the native list appears normally.

versions.title: Compact player secondary controls under 600px (batch round 06/20)
versions.description: P5.1.82 actual 450px TV screenshot had a tiny 200px video and 160px secondary control panel, with two select dropdowns needlessly stacked despite room for them side by side. Grid layout now keeps EPG on its own row, fit + manual backup URL + favorite in a common row. All native controls remain addressable, no state or playlist changes.

versions.title: Single-row mobile channel chooser (new batch round 05/20)
versions.description: The freshly reviewed P5.1.81 real 450px Electron screenshot revealed that the native `webChannelChooser` beneath the overlay wraps its three filter tabs into two rows, pushing the Recent tab down and wasting scarce height. Under 600px, retain all three native tabs and both layout toggles in a 3-column CSS grid + compact two-button view control, with readable focus states and theme-aware selected color. Do not remove controls or alter filtering behavior.

versions.title: Single-row WatchFlow Plus toolbar (this batch round 04/20)
versions.description: Actual P5.1.80 Electron mix screenshot showed the new five modes wrapped awkwardly into two rows, covering player content and reducing the visible card list. Shorten only the visual button captions and preserve complete localized names via aria-label/title. Force one logical row at desktop and allow horizontal scrolling for very narrow screens; maintain all five mode buttons, Smart Zap manual-only playback and keyboard controls.

versions.title: WatchFlow Plus
versions.description: **Smart Zap**: một nút chuyển sang kênh khác theo tình trạng nguồn, bỏ kênh đã chết, tránh kênh đang phát và kênh vừa chuyển; chỉ phát sau thao tác người dùng. **Tiếp tục xem**: đọc lịch sử phát đã xác minh khung hình, sử dụng native Recent Channels, không ghi nhận việc phát không thành công.

versions.title: Understandable player tools disclosure (new batch 03/20)
versions.description: P5.1.78 real Electron TV shows a trailing `•••` icon that does not communicate the Timeshift/recording/tool collection and looks out-of-place against the other monochrome player icons. Render a monochrome sliders SVG as part of the existing native toggle in `positron-fifty.js`, overriding only the legacy pseudo-element dots; retain the actual button, its localized text, click handler, aria-expanded, tooltip and saved open/closed state.

versions.title: Focused empty Doctor onboarding (new batch 02/20)
versions.description: P5.1.77 actual no-source Electron Doctor screenshot still had six zero-value metrics taking an entire horizontal row, despite advanced diagnostic panels being correctly hidden. While native channel count is zero, hide only `.doctor-metrics` and render a purposeful, labeled introduction with direct access to native source manager; keep both original Doctor V2/V3 sections, all report DOM, and preferences untouched. Restore the complete metric dashboard automatically when actual native channels are added.

versions.title: Doctor source CTA screenshot smoke regression (new batch 01/20)
versions.description: P5.1.76 capture failed: screenshot shows the native `#positronDoctorSources` source-import action, but added QA mistakenly looked for an element inside `#doctorReport`. Check the actual native action's visibility and text, simulate its click and assert successful navigation to the native Sources page, then restore Doctor. Preserve empty V2/V3 hiding and full restoration when channels exist.

versions.title: Smart Doctor zero-source onboarding (new batch 06/20)
versions.description: Real P5.1.75 Electron Doctor with 0 playlist channels shows a large noninteractive V3 diagnostics page after the native message to add sources. Keep the native import action, safety report and six counters but collapse unused V3/V2 analytics until native channels exist. Observe channel count and automatically restore all original controls on import, without modifying user preferences/history.

versions.title: truthful Video Lab beta (new batch 05/20)
versions.description: P5.1.74 real TV screenshot shows a prominent ‘Nâng cao video bằng AI’ control even though Electron implementation explicitly lacks any live upscale backend; its Apply button does not affect streams. Renamed to ‘Video Lab · Beta’, added honest warning tooltip, renamed fake Apply to capability status, and de-emphasized beta visual chrome. Preserved experimental benchmark, settings, data and real playback.

versions.title: no-source TV workspace uses laptop height intelligently (new batch 04/20)
versions.description: P5.1.73 actual Electron TV at 1360x820 displayed a 538px empty video stage, pushing useful controls below the fold. On desktop viewports shorter than 900px, only the no-video stage is shortened to provide access to controls. It retains a fluid floor of 280px and bypasses fullscreen. When the player starts video, the original native 16:9 frame remains unchanged.

versions.title: labeled and safe DVR recording path (new batch 03/20)
versions.description: P5.1.72 real Electron EPG 720 screenshot revealed an unlabeled absolute path beside the folder control. It will wrap badly for long localized user profiles. Added a labeled path field while retaining native `#dvrDirectory` and `#dvrChooseDir`, responsive grid and complete hover tooltip mirrored from the actual native path via MutationObserver. No filesystem calls or data mutations.

versions.title: Smart Discovery with ordered, usable filters (new 20-round batch 02)
versions.description: P5.1.71 real Electron Sources screenshots show the primary Discover button between Country and Scan scope, and Cancel separated onto a new row at 1360px. Reorder actual native DOM fields so keyboard tab order matches display; use Horizon-only responsive 4-column desktop, 2-column tablet and 1-column narrow Discovery layout. Keep catalog, country, unlimited scope, concurrency, Verify and Cancel IDs/events intact.

versions.title: WatchFlow contextual to TV (new 20-round batch 01)
versions.description: Actual P5.1.70 Sources screenshots at 1360 and 720px show TV-specific WatchFlow in source management. Opening is now guarded to TV; changing tabs hides the button and dialog, keeps focus accessible, and restores WatchFlow on return. Native channel rank, play events, playlists, preferences and rights consent are untouched.

versions.title: Source selected-section state and accessible current location
versions.description: Fix: existing buttons now expose exactly one `aria-current=location` and high-contrast teal selection; clicking each native button updates visual and screen-reader feedback without replacing source jump listeners or mutating IPTV data.

versions.title: Source navigation orphan-row responsive repair
versions.description: Cause: legacy `.sources-hub-nav{flex-wrap:wrap}` with button 16px horizontal padding forces an orphan fifth tab at 720px. Fix: in Horizon Sources at <=900px, use compact 10px button padding, nowrap flex, accessible horizontal overflow scroll on narrower viewports. Preserve native data-source-jump and input behaviors.

versions.title: Thay đổi được ghi nhận trong mã nguồn
versions.description: Fix: create exactly one four-tile inline SVG in the existing native disclosure button, preserve JS event, aria-expanded, local storage and label in expanded rail; suppress legacy pseudo glyphs under scoped Horizon CSS.

versions.title: Thay đổi được ghi nhận trong mã nguồn
versions.description: Fix: observe only real TV page active class. If user navigates away, close WatchFlow without mutating current playlist, selected channel or any source. Preserve existing pointer/Escape pathways.

versions.title: Thay đổi được ghi nhận trong mã nguồn

versions.title: Horizon populated folder contrast repair

versions.title: WatchFlow group-balanced local recommendations
